Startech24.de is proud to present Duravolta, our high-performance electrical insulation and flame-retardant film, at the Battery Show Stuttgart. Designed for demanding applications in battery systems, electronics, and e-mobility, Duravolta combines excellent dielectric strength with outstanding thermal and flame-resistant properties.

We supply this advanced material both as sheets and roll stock, ensuring flexibility for a wide range of industrial requirements. Beyond material supply, Startech24 offers comprehensive processing capabilities, including precision die cutting, bending, laminating, thermoforming, and the application of self-adhesive layers.

Our solutions are tailored to meet customer-specific designs, enabling efficient integration into modern battery modules and electrical components. In addition to Duravolta, we provide a broad portfolio of electrical insulation films to suit various technical demands.

With our expertise in materials and processing, we support our customers from concept to production. Visit us at the Battery Show Stuttgart to discover how Startech24 can enhance your applications with reliable and innovative insulation solutions.
Experienced industrial automation and integration company with interest in BESS and similar systems. Developing our own custom EMS.

4a engineering GmbH, based in Traboch, Austria, specializes, among others, in battery abuse testing services and the development of advanced battery abuse test equipment. The company designs and manufactures state-of-the-art testing systems, including pressure-tight thermal runaway chambers for electro-thermal-mechanical testing of cells, modules, and small packs, as well as mechanical testing systems for characterizing battery cells. With extensive expertise in battery safety, abuse simulation, and custom testing solutions, 4a engineering supports the development and validation of next-generation battery technologies. Exhibiting at the Battery Show Europe 2026 in Stuttgart, 4a engineering is a trusted partner for tailored testing solutions and cutting-edge equipment to ensure battery performance and safety. Whether you need precision test systems or expert services for battery safety testing, 4a engineering delivers excellence in every project. Keywords: battery abuse testing, thermal runaway chambers, mechanical testing systems, battery safety testing, battery simulation, test equipment.

A123 Systems develops advanced lithium‑ion batteries using proprietary LFP technology for automotive and energy‑storage applications, serving global OEMs with high‑performance, safe, and reliable solutions. Founded in 2001, it is part of the Wanxiang Group and holds hundreds of core patents.

Every year, Cambridge EnerTech unites 5,000+ top battery technologists from leading OEMs, cell manufacturers, pack integrators, and the entire supply chain. Upcoming events include: the co-located Solid-State and Battery Safety Summits in August in Chicago, AABC in December in San Diego, and the International Battery Seminar in Florida in March. The International Battery Seminar is the longest-running annual battery event in the world and will be launching an inaugural European event in Mainz, Germany in June of 2027.

Founded in 2006,ACME is a National Key High-tech Enterprise in production of Special Materials and Special Thermal Equipment.
Our core thermal equipment portfolio is widely recognized in key fields such as organic solid waste treatment, advanced composite materials, semiconductors, and vacuum thermal processing. In battery recycling, the solid waste thermal pyrolysis equipment effectively processes lithium batteries, tires, circuit boards, and more. 
Leveraging years of expertise in heating equipment technology, our solutions ensure efficient, safe, and environmentally friendly processing of battery-related wastes.
ACME has provided waste battery recycling treatment equipment for well-known enterprises globally, such as GEM,Huayou Cobalt,CNGR,Ruicycle and etc. Over the years, the company adheres to the concept of "innovation, service, creating value for customers", takes scientific and technological innovation as the core, takes a specialized and special new road, and is committed to becoming a leader in the field of "special materials and special thermal equipment".

The solutions from acp systems AG make it a global technology leader in advanced clean production, including process automation and system integration. The company was founded in 1997 and has its headquarters in Germany. Its core technologies include resource-saving quattroClean snow-jet cleaning, high-precision microdosing and smart handling solutions, for example for flexible materials and foils. acp assists companies from the semiconductor, electronics, automotive, precision optics, medical device and pharmaceutical industries and others, in developing, planning, designing and integrating highly-automated and sustainable production processes. acp's capabilities in battery production span from cleaning of contacts, frames and housing to remove contamination and electrolyte to the system development, design and implementation of e.g. a format flexible winding machine for jelly roll production or a system for battery pack recycling.

As a global technology leader, Adhesives Research provides connectivity, thermal management, and moisture barrier protection to critical electronics segments, including Electric Vehicle (EV) Battery production. AR’s portfolio of pressure sensitive tapes are designed for a broad range of applications throughout the cell, module, and pack, including electrode and conductive bonding, encapsulation, device wrapping, shock absorbency, and process aids. Our chemists and engineers are passionate about developing novel products that enable our customers to overcome challenging applications in meeting the demands of an ever-evolving EV Battery market.

Adhex is a Tier-1 automotive supplier with over 60 years of expertise in pressure-sensitive adhesive technologies. We partner with OEMs and battery manufacturers to solve the material challenges that matter most: breathing and swelling management, electrical insulation, thermal management and assembly efficiency.

Our portfolio of films, foams, tapes, and precision die-cut components is engineered for cells, modules, and packs — and backed by R&D and industrialization capabilities supporting projects from early development through serial production.

Headquartered in Dijon, France, with operations in Spain, Slovakia, and Brazil, we work close to our customers to deliver the responsiveness and supply reliability that global battery programs demand.

ADLER ELECTRIC delivers top-tier, internationally certified DC fuses for the electric vehicle, electric power utility, and photovoltaic industries. We offer the fastest lead times, exceptional service, and zero minimum order quantities – giving developers and buyers unmatched flexibility.

ADVANTAGE AUSTRIA, with around 100 offices in over 70 countries, provides a broad range of intelligence and business development services for both Austrian companies and their international business partners. Around 800 employees  around the world can assist you in locating Austrian suppliers and business partners. We organize about 800 events every year to bring business contacts together. Other services provided by ADVANTAGE AUSTRIA offices range from introductions to Austrian companies looking for importers, distributors or agents to providing in-depth information on Austria as a business location and assistance in entering the Austrian market.

ADVANTAGE AUSTRIA works to generate more international business opportunities by promoting the products and services of Austrian businesses around the world, by helping companies and organisations outside Austria to build strong relationships with Austrian companies and by fostering the exchange of the world’s and Austria’s best minds and innovations.

Corporate Structure: AdvanTech International, established in 1951 as an international trading company has evolved into a global sales and market development organization. Driving product leadership, AdvanTech partners with global leading manufacturers to deliver engineered product solutions through our strategically located operations. The Vehicle Components Group offers cutting edge component solutions including metal forming technologies such as precision cold forming, light weight high-pressure die casting, hot forging and precision stampings. New Products development being introduced at EV/HEV Technology show includes our Battery Cooling Plate, Heat-Sinks with Micro fins and magnesium diecasting.

As a global leader in laboratory technologies, Agilent supports the lithium-ion battery industry with advanced analytical instruments, vacuum and leak detection equipment, and comprehensive laboratory supplies. Our reliable chromatography, mass spectrometry, and spectroscopy instruments meet critical testing needs across the battery supply chain. We ensure high standards of quality and efficiency with tailored solutions and provide essential spares, consumables, and certified reference materials. By offering analytical method development and application consulting, we help optimize testing economics and support the entire battery workflow, driving advancements and sustainability in the industry.

Agratas is a global battery business within the Tata Group. We’ll design, develop and manufacture high-quality, high-performance, sustainable battery solutions. We’ve entered our industrialisation phase, building world-class battery manufacturing facilities in Sanand, India, and in Bridgwater, UK, unlocking green growth opportunities for global customers in the mobility and energy sectors. We’re powering the energy transition – not just by making batteries, but by driving momentum for a better tomorrow. Whether it’s for electric vehicles or grid energy storage, our technology is designed to move people, industries, and ideas forward. We believe the energy revolution should be shaped by people, for people – and that’s exactly what we’re building. For more information, visit us at Hall 1, Stand E11.

The AICHELIN Group, part of Berndorf AG, is a leading global provider of heat treatment solutions headquartered near Vienna, Austria. Its portfolio includes industrial furnaces, heating systems, control and automation solutions, and Industry 4.0 services. Founded in 1868, AICHELIN operates through brands like AFC-Holcroft, SAFED, BOSIO, and NOXMAT, with subsidiaries in Austria, Germany, Slovenia, France, Türkiye, China, India, and the USA, plus a sales network in 22 additional countries.

KILNPARTNER, established in 2011, specializes in industrial kiln systems and automated thermal processing for industries such as Li-ion and Sodium-ion batteries, honeycomb ceramics, 5G communication, electronic ceramics, and magnetic materials. In late 2022, AICHELIN and KILNPARTNER partnered to jointly develop, manufacture, and support advanced heat treatment solutions for European battery manufacturers.

Unique in the market, we provide both battery protection solutions and battery testing services. We're on a mission to redefine battery safety and are on-hand to share insights, recommendations, and testing knowledge to ensure the successful integration of our products into your battery systems.

The AIT Austrian Institute of Technology is Austria's largest research and technology organisation and a specialist in the key infrastructure issues of the future. One main research area is Battery Technologies: The scientists at AIT are pursuing a holistic research approach to make batteries more sustainable, efficient, powerful, cost-effective and safer. The battery development process covers the whole value chain – from synthesis of advanced battery materials, through electrode and cell manufacturing, battery testing, diagnostic and simulation, up to post-mortem analysis. The focus is primarily on the development of high-performance cathodes and high-energy anode materials as well as on the optimisation of known cell chemistries. A dry room with a state-of-the-art research pilot line for pouch cell manufacturing enables prototyping of lithium ion cells and brings fundamental research closer to industrial production to bridge the gap between academia and industry.

Akku Power has been one of the most successful international battery pack system manufacturers in Germany for more than 25 years. Our strength lies within competent consulting and development, as well as in the implementation of complex, high-quality and powerful battery system solutions for a wide range of applications.

AKM Meadville Electronics (Xiamen) is a leading supplier of high-end PCBs and packaging substrates for the global automotive industry. Headquartered in Xiamen, China, it operates across Asia, Europe, and North America, with seven domestic plants and one in Thailand. Specializing in HDI, rigid-flex, flex, and power battery modules, the company leverages digital twins and AI for smart manufacturing with full traceability. Holding over 1,000 patents, it provides advanced circuit solutions to top automotive brands, enabling ADAS, infotainment, EV battery management, and intelligent driving systems, empowering the future of mobility.

AkzoNobel Powder Coatings is one of the largest global manufacturers of powder coatings. Our Resicoat brand has a proven track record since more than 50 years in electrical insulation and corrosion protection.

Resicoat EV powder coatings have been innovated specifically to enhance the safety and performance of Electrical Vehicles with superior electrical insulating properties and enhanced thermal management to help protect the battery systems, motors and electrical storage units. 

Our Powder Coating solutions for Electric vehicles: 
-	Battery cells
-	Battery housings
-	Battery modules
-	Busbars
-	Cooling plates
-	Cooling tubes
-	Hairpin stators.

Different Resicoat grades with UL listings for UL 94 (V-0) as well as UL 1446 Class F and Class H with outstanding resistance against heat, chemicals and moisture are available.

Alabama is a top five automotive manufacturing state with five OEMs Mercedes, Honda, Hyundai, Toyota and Mazda. 15 different cars, SUVs and trucks, including, all-electric vehicles. The European Office of the Alabama Department of Commerce maintains relations with European companies and promotes trade between Alabama and European industries. OEMs have invested heavily in Electric Vehicles, EV Technologies and battery manufacturing in recent years. Alabama attract foreign investment in EV technology, infrastructure, and manufacturing beside others with: - Alabama Mobility and Power (AMP) center - Alabama is building a $30 million workforce training center wiht focus on electric vehicles - EV Workforce Strategy Alabama We also support companies on the great advantages and opportunities stemming from a potential investment in Alabama. We also actively support employee recruitment and training at no cost to the company.

Albright International have over 75 years’ experience in designing D.C. contactors and emergency disconnects with a dedicated design centre and the latest/hi-tech design facilities. Our contactors are available in Normally Open, Normally Closed and Changeover configurations with current ratings up to 2400 Amperes. The contactor options include IP69K sealing, bracket configurations, Auxiliary switches and Manual Overrides. Our Emergency Battery Disconnect and Combined Disconnect Switches are manufactured in Single and Double Pole variants and have current ratings from 100 to 1800 Amperes Continuous rating. We will be showcasing our latest range of 1000V high voltage contactors and will be located at booth 5G25 where we will be able to provide advice and offer our latest products suitable for battery management systems and HV/EV technology.

Alkegen is a world leader in filtration and catalysis media, specialty insulation used for fossil fuel reduction and emission control products and high growth battery materials and technologies designed to enhance safety and improve battery performance. 
 
The Alkegen Battery Group will be exhibiting thermal, fire, electrical and blast resistant protections for the cell, module and pack that help prevent thermal runaway propagation; sealing materials for battery cases and electric motors; advanced silicon anode technology for increased energy density and faster charging times and engineered thermally stable separator technologies. 

Alkegen has a global base of 7,500+ employees, and 60+ global manufacturing locations and our products help people breathe easier, live greener, and go further than ever before.

Almatis - Innovate Alumina and beyond for tomorrow - Almatis is the global leader in specialty alumina solutions, driving innovation, sustainability, and reliability. Serving industries from steelmaking and technical ceramics to medical applications and thermal management, Almatis products enhance efficiency, reduce energy consumption, and lower carbon footprints. Our advanced solutions, such as ECO-TAB®, improve resource savings and material efficiency while ensuring long refractory life. We also offer high-purity, ultra-low soda aluminas for ceramics, semiconductors, and polishing applications as well as Calcium Aluminate Cements for refractory and building chemistry applications. With over 100 years of expertise, over 900 employees, and 7 production sites, 5 sales office and 5 application labs worldwide, Almatis remains committed to local supply chains and industry-leading performance. Think alumina, think Almatis.

ALT Technologies is an innovative global foil and tape converting company. Our products include electronics protection insulation materials, compression pads, hybrid solutions, thin-foil heaters (PTC/FPC), die-cut flexible conductive components, and warning & traceability labels, including RFID. We offer co-engineering solutions from an infinite material database. An essential aspect of our work is rooted in 50+ years of adhesive knowledge. As a preferred supplier to the automotive industry, we are well-versed in OEM specifications. Our core capabilities include laminating, printing, and precision die-cutting, and we develop application-specific solutions working alongside renowned OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers. Our engineers and business development managers who will be attending The Battery Show Europe 2026 are Jan van Honk, Jelmer Sminia, Mario Schmid, Abdoulaye Ndoye, and Lutz Heukelbach.

Over the past 130 years, ALTEO has evolved into a leading global supplier of specialty aluminas, providing an extending range from ATH to calcined, low soda, White fused aluminas and high purity aluminas, for many markets such as lithium-ion battery, thermal management, advanced ceramics and high-performance refractories. Located in France, with production facilities in Taiwan and South Korea, it supplies more than 600 customers worldwide. To ensure the best quality of products and services, ALTEO continuously invests in the latest production equipment, applied research and technical expertise.

Altran Magnetics Inc. is a solution provider of DC Contactors. With around 100 P/N’s in its portfolio, it is a leader in DC contactor technologies ranging from battery management systems to electric vehicle power systems. Understanding that every application has its own unique electrical, mechanical, and thermal requirements, its global design team can provide products to meet your specific application requirements.

With headquarters in Lévis, Québec, Canada and Lake Mary, Florida, USA, FARO CREAFORM is the result of the combination of FARO’s renowned 3D Measurement business segment and Creaform’s innovative metrology solutions. With roots dating back to 1981, FARO has been a global leader in portable measurement arms, laser trackers, and reality capture technologies. Creaform, founded in 2002 in Lévis, Québec, has revolutionized handheld 3D scanning and automated inspection, serving thousands of professionals in automotive, aerospace, manufacturing, and research. Together, FARO CREAFORM empowers quality, production, maintenance and design teams to work faster, smarter, and with total confidence, unlocking better outcomes and superior experiences across manufacturing workflows. FARO CREAFORM is a business unit of AMETEK, Inc., a leading global provider of industrial technology solutions serving a diverse set of attractive niche markets with annual sales of over $7.5 billion.

AMETEK Surface Vision is the world leader in automated online surface inspection solutions. Our broad product range is optimized for the monitoring and inspection of webs and surfaces, and for process surveillance applications. The SmartView® and SmartAdvisor® product lines deliver robust, flexible solutions to continuous production processes across a number of industries, with hundreds of customers and more than 3,000 installations worldwide. Our systems have become vital to increasing efficiency, streamlining operations, improving product quality and reducing costs and waste in industrial processes.

Amium develops modular systems for gas analysis and battery testing that enable precise, safety-critical measurements in automotive test benches and research environments. The integrated development of hardware and software creates scalable solutions with high integration capability and compatibility with existing system landscapes. Amium systems are used worldwide in demanding test and development environments.

AMPHENOL is US based Corporation. With our 100,000 employees and locations spread all over the world we offer our customers exceptional technical support, technology, logistics and service in the areas of design and manufacturing and are a globally trusted market leader. We are connecting and providing the power and data transmission in nearly every industrial field. Our experts collaborate with customers enabling smarter, faster, better technologies to connect products to customer solutions.

Anaphite is the World Leader in chemical technologies for dry coating of Lithium-ion battery electrodes. Dry electrode coating is the future of battery manufacturing, delivering up to 40% reduction in production costs and 30% reduction in energy consumption. Anaphite's proprietary DCP® process produces fully formulated Dry Coating Precursor (DCP®) powders ready for dry coating. DCP® safely and effectively combines cathode active material, binders and conductive additives including advanced carbons such as carbon nanotubes to produce a well-structured homogeneous powder. Anaphite's DCP® powders are tailor-formulated to customer specifications, enabling them to move from today's energy intensive wet coating manufacturing processes to dry processes without compromising product performance.

ANDRITZ world of Battery equipment and solutions

As more electric vehicles hit the road, the need for batteries to power them grows enormous. ANDRITZ offers innovative solutions for several stages of the battery manufacturing process. From raw material processing to cell assembly and finishing, testing and recycling. Our production lines are designed to prioritize efficiency and innovation, ensuring that we meet the highest standards in the industry. We have established global engineering partnerships and are dedicated to offering reliable local support with an emphasis on sustainability.

Within the ANDRITZ Group, we can stimulate growth in the battery industry by developing safer, more efficient and faster-charging battery manufacturing technologies for e-mobility, ESS and any other applications.

ANDRITZ Separation offers solutions that can increase capacity and reduce production costs for a range of battery minerals. The broad portfolio of technologies for mechanical separation as well as thermal treatment gives us the flexibility to tailor a solution to the process and recipe of each manufacturer. Combined with process simulation technology, machine and process control and proven local service, we are proud to be able to offer the full package from simulation to installation and process optimization for every step from lithium mining and battery mineral processing down to hydrometallurgical recycling. We provide shredding, dewatering, and drying equipment to recover valuable raw materials, such as lithium, cobalt, or graphite.

ANDRITZ world of Battery equipment and solutions

As more electric vehicles hit the road, the need for batteries to power them grows enormous. ANDRITZ offers innovative solutions for several stages of the battery manufacturing process. From raw material processing to cell assembly and finishing, testing and recycling. Our production lines are designed to prioritize efficiency and innovation, ensuring that we meet the highest standards in the industry. We have established global engineering partnerships and are dedicated to offering reliable local support with an emphasis on sustainability.

Within the ANDRITZ Group, we can stimulate growth in the battery industry by developing safer, more efficient and faster-charging battery manufacturing technologies for e-mobility, ESS and any other applications.

Angelini Technologies is the industrial technology division of Angelini Industries, a Group operating in 21 countries worldwide with 5,800 employees in the healthcare, industrial technology, and consumer goods sectors. Together with Fameccanica as main company founded in 1975 - with over 700 employees and more than 1,200 current patent rights - it operates in the Converting and Automation & Robotics areas.

XOANONS specializes in manufacturing dispersants for the new energy industry. Its products are used in LFP carbon coating, lipophilic alumina, aqueous PVDF, conductive carbon black, SWCNT, and LFP/LMFP/LCO cell slurry. Its fast-charging dispersant LD1128-20 for LFP batteries has been successfully applied in vehicles.

As a specialized system partner for industrial lithium-ion solutions, ANSMANN AG combines German engineering with global manufacturing expertise. Acting as an extension of development departments, custom energy concepts are realized—from optimal cell selection and complex BMS design to series maturity. A decisive advantage for time-to-market is the accredited UN test center at the headquarters in Assamstadt. Here, safety and transport capability are validated directly in-house, significantly shortening development cycles. With 35 years of experience, ANSMANN offers technological excellence "Engineered in Germany" alongside certified sustainability, demonstrated by the EcoVadis Silver Medal and the nomination for the German Sustainability Award. Intelligent charging technology and battery packs are integrated into robust complete systems, tailored exactly to the specific application. Whether for robotics, medical technology, or IoT, mobile energy is delivered to make products competitive. ANSMANN combines innovation, safety, and ecological responsibility to successfully push technical boundaries.

Anupam Rasayan India Ltd. is a life science company with a rich history spanning over more than four decades with business model of custom synthesis and custom manufacturing. Our expertise lies in various fields, including Agro Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Personal Care, Polymers, Electronic Chemicals and EV Chemicals. With currently 8 well-established manufacturing sites in India along with two large scale R&D centers, we are committed to bringing innovation and cutting-edge chemistries to life. We are proud to be GOI certified star export house. Our reach extends across globe specially in Europe, USA, Japan, and Asia, serving major multinational customers across industries.

Applus+ IDIADA – Battery Systems Testing & Engineering Excellence

Applus+ IDIADA is a global automotive industry partner with 30+ years of expertise, delivering comprehensive battery development, testing, and validation services for electric and hybrid vehicles. Our state-of-the-art facilities feature advanced climatized test benches (-45°C to 75°C), high-power cyclers up to 500kW, and over 2000m² of dedicated safety testing space with gas scrubbing systems.

We provide end-to-end solutions spanning the complete battery lifecycle: cell selection and integration, battery architecture design, BMS development, thermal system engineering, and virtual modeling. Our testing capabilities include aging and performance validation, abuse testing, and safety validation across electrical, thermal, and mechanical scenarios—all compliant with international standards (ECE R100.03, UN 38.3, FreedomCAR).

From initial concept through full vehicle validation, IDIADA supports BEV, HEV, PHEV, and FCEV applications, ensuring battery systems meet the highest standards of performance, safety, and reliability.

About ARaymond
With more than 8,000 employees in 25 countries around the world, the ARaymond Network designs, manufactures and markets assembly and fastening systems. Founded in 1865, this family business based in Grenoble, France, and the inventor of the press stud, has always put human values at the heart of its success. ARaymond, is based on the conviction that the well-being and empowerment of its collaborators are essential to its continued success. Guided by innovation and sustainable value creation, the ARaymond Network is today one of the global leaders in fastening and assembly solutions for the automotive, energy, agriculture, and healthcare markets.

Arbin is the leading global supplier of multi-channeled potentiostat/galvanostat testing systems for every energy storage device application. This includes materials research, batteries, capacitors, x-EVs, flow batteries, fuel cells and humidifiers. We cover applications ranging from nano-amps up to thousands of amps. Arbin is a multi-million dollar corporation nestled in the heart of Texas with thousands of systems in operation in over 50 countries. Our success is due to the advanced product features we provide and have often pioneered, the knowledge and service provided by our team, and the extraordinary goals established by management that place a strong emphasis on R&D. Arbin balances innovation and experience with the flexibility to always take on new challenges, and in recent years has partnered with fellow industry leaders for ARPA research projects. All of these aspects combined set us apart from competitors and drive our continued growth and improvement.

The Argomm Group is an international group of industrial companies headquartered in Italy that for over 40 years has been synonymous with reliability and professionalism in the entire cycle of design, development, production and supply of custom parts in elastomer, plastic and bi-component materials for AUTOMOTIVE sector. The Argomm Group's global presence and synergy of skills enables it to act as a single point of contact for customers in the manufacture of custom parts for integrated sealing systems: from the design and co-design of the shape to research and testing of materials, prototyping (including rapid prototyping), functional testing and industrialisation, right up to mass production. Reliability is the most important feature of the solutions offered by the Argomm Group: solutions designed and manufactured to specific customer requirements with the aim of ensuring the highest quality performance in compliance with costs and service.

Based in France, Argylium is the most advanced company in Europe in the research, development and industrialization of Sulfides Solid Electrolytes. By joining the forces of 3 pioneering industrial players, Argylium helps to accelerate the transition toward next-generation energy solutions. With Syensqo All Solid State Batteries Team, Axens’ deep expertise in inorganic chemistry and industrial process scale-up, and IFPEN’s renowned know-how in materials science, Argylium commits to leading the design and industrial production of high-performance Sulfide Solid Electrolytes for All Solid State Battery markets. 

With over 10 years of experience in this field, a world-class R&D team and unique large assets, Argylium is the priviledged partner that supports industries in the design of tomorrow’s breakthrough innovations.

Building on its unique set of expertise in materials science, Arkema offers a portfolio of first-class technologies to address ever-growing demand for new and more sustainable materials. With the ambition to become a world leader in Specialty Materials, the Group is structured into three complementary, resilient and highly innovative segments dedicated to Specialty Materials - Adhesive Solutions, Advanced Materials, and Coating Solutions - accounting for some 85% of Group sales in 2025, and a Primary Materials segment regrouping well-positioned large scale industrials activities. Arkema offers cutting-edge technological solutions to meet the challenges of, among other things, new energies, access to water, recycling, urbanization and mobility, and fosters a permanent dialogue with all its stakeholders. The Group reported sales of around €9.1 billion in 2025 and operates in some 55 countries with 20, 700 employees worldwide.

ARMOR BATTERY FILMS offers a wide range of carbon coated current collectors - aluminum and copper foils with a thin protective and conductive layer - specifically design to improve the interface between the anode/cathode and the foil. En’ Safe® is design to fit with various electrochemistries. The product design is adaptable based on requirements, such as foil width or coating pattern. En’ Safe® current collectors contribute to advanced energy storage systems innovation. ARMOR BATTERY FILMS is part of ARMOR GROUP, an industrial group with more than 100 years expertise in chemical formulation and high precision coating.

Filtration of coatings, more in particular cathode and anode slurries. Using filter cartridges, filter capsules or automated filtration systems. Profound expertise and consultancy on filtration of high viscosity and/or high solid containing and thixotropic liquids.

artron | Toa Electric Industrial Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based technology trading company with engineering and production capabilities, offering specialized solutions for EV and HEV battery, motor, and powertrain applications. Our portfolio includes high-performance components such as thermal expansion rubbers, venting systems, Fire-resistant sheet, Thermistor and Flat cable—each engineered to meet the safety, thermal, and durability demands of next-generation mobility. Backed by over 70 years of experience, we support Tier 1 suppliers and OEMs with deep technical expertise and flexible collaboration. Let us support your most demanding technical and functional challenges with deep expertise and trusted partnership.

From flame-retardant thermoplastics for insulating and structural parts of the battery case to Li-ion battery separators and electrolytes, the Asahi Kasei Group / Celgard is a one-stop provider for components which significantly improve safety, efficiency and performance of automotive batteries.

Always aiming to offer the best outcome to our customers, ASAŞ contributes to the development of projects as a solution partner in international projects with its highly expertized engineering team, while offering innovations for our customers to realize their designs more versatile thanks to continuous investments in technology.

fields.exhdesc_t: Ashland is a global additives and specialty ingredients company with a conscious and proactive mindset for environment, social and governance (ESG). The company serves customers in a wide range of consumer and industrial markets, including architectural coatings, automotive, construction, energy, food and beverage, nutraceuticals, personal care and pharmaceuticals in 100 countries. Specifically, Ashland supplies specialty additives and ingredients for binders, dispersants and solvents for lithium-ion batteries.

ASPILSAN Enerji, established in 1981 in Turkey, is a pioneer in the energy sector specializing in advanced battery technology. The main activities and solutions of ASPILSAN Enerji are: INR18650 Lithium-Ion Rechargeable Cylindrical Battery Production Different Cell Chemistry Sale Radio and Weapon Battery Systems Telecommunication Batteries Medical Battery Systems Mini ESS and Energy Storage Systems Aviation Battery Systems and Battery Batteries (Lithium-Ion and Nickel Cadmium) Marine Battery Systems Railway Battery Systems Robotics and Autonomous Battery Systems Engineering and Test Services PCB Assembly Our commitment to innovation is evident in development of high-quality, efficient batteries, particularly for electric vehicles (EVs), aligning perfectly with the themes of the EV Show & The Battery Show Europe. For more information, please visit our website!

Association for Roll-to-Roll Converters (ARC) The Association for Roll-to-Roll Converters, formerly AIMCAL, promotes the converting industry and its members and delivers an array of services focused on providing cutting-edge science and technology through top-tier technical training and education and the most comprehensive library of technical resources in the converting industry. Headquartered in Greenville, South Carolina, USA, membership of the global group stands at more than 300 companies. Membership information is available at www.rolltoroll.org. Offering R2R Conferences in USA, Europe, & Asia. Providing technical education on Battery Manufacturing, Flexible Packaging, Coating, Laminating, & Adhesives, Web Handling, Printing, Vacuum Web Coating, Flexible Electronics, & Sustainability. And these are the core focus areas of our member companies. We cover all segments of roll-to-roll manufacturing.

Asterisco Tech designs and manufactures tailored testing solutions for validation and end-of-line production of electric, electronic, mechanic and hydraulic devices. Our main fields of application are aerospace and automotive industries. Over the past five years, following the automotive industry transition towards electrification, we have specialized in the field of electric mobility applications.  Our expertise include testing systems for electric motors, inverters, electric powertrains, onboard chargers, power converters, battery managment systems, battery cells, battery modules and battery packs.

Astotec Automotive, headquartered in Hirtenberg, Austria, specializes in the development and production of highly innovative, pyrotechnic products and solutions for passive safety-related applications in the automotive industry. 
Further facilities are located in Hungary, Czech Republic, US and China.
Our high voltage circuit breakers (pyro-fuses) disconnect the power train from the battery system within milliseconds, preventing vehicle fires and protecting the occupants. 
Our circuit closers provide a secure and irreversible electrical connection to short a load circuit or discharge a capacitor. 
Astotec Automotive's electrical safety products are developed to latest customer needs and tested at our fully equipped in-house development center.

Athena is a global leader in high-performance solutions for the automotive, industrial, and energy sectors. With over 50 years of experience, it partners with OEMs to deliver advanced materials and tailor-made components for mobility and energy storage. Batemo is the global technology leader in development of lithium-ion battery simulation software - built on years of independent lab measurements and high‑fidelity cell-models. BATTECH is a Joint Research Unit in the field of batteries, promoted and established by the Energy Research Institute of Catalonia (IREC) and the EURECAT Technology Center, to cover the entire battery value chain.
BATTECH promotes and participates in research, development, testing, and innovation projects with the aim of improving knowledge transfer to the industry in the field of electrochemical batteries, always from a perspective focused on the circular economy and sustainability.
BATTECH comprises a total of 17 research groups and technological units from IREC and Eurecat, providing strong multidisciplinary and multisectoral capacity to tackle the major scientific and technological industrial challenges in the field of electric battery storage, from TRLs 2-4 to TRLs 6-8 (TRL: Technological Readiness Levels), with more than 50 fully dedicated researchers and technologists.
Recently, BATTECH has completed two major European reference projects in the new generation of cells and batteries: Cobra and Marbel, coordinated by IREC and Eurecat respectively. It is currently involved in 11 other European research projects H2020 and HE, other national R&D projects, and supports many companies in their research, development, and innovation projects, as well as in the training of their staff.

Battera also has experience in battery pack assembly, integration of Battery Management Systems, quality control, traceability processes, end-of-line testing and manufacturing operations for both low-voltage and high-voltage battery systems.

fields.exhdesc_t: Bender GmbH & Co. KG is a globally active medium-sized family company and leading provider of top-class electrical safety products and solutions. The basic aim is to be able to charge electric vehicles from virtually any socket. This means different networks and protective measures can come together during the charging process. This requires careful coordination and implementation of all measures in order to guarantee comprehensive electrical safety for the user here too. In the vehicle, there are various voltages which require careful coordination of protective measures to control them. Insulation faults in the Class B voltage system (on-board network) caused by, for example, contamination, humidity, faulty connections, etc. must be avoided or detected and remedied. Bender devices make sure that electric vehicles (EV) can be charged safely and reliably - in accordance with the normative requirements for the charging process.

The platform covers the entire lifecycle—from connecting existing data sources and structuring distributed supply chain data to providing relevant information in a standardized format.

Many companies struggle with fragmented data sources, limited transparency, and high integration effort. SecIdent addresses these challenges by connecting existing systems and consistently structuring heterogeneous data. This creates a reliable data foundation for the Battery Passport—without media disruptions or additional isolated solutions.

The solution enables end-to-end traceability, supports regulatory compliance, and makes battery-related data accessible in a structured way for all relevant stakeholders across the supply chain.

In the automotive sector, where efficient energy management is essential for achieving high performance, Brar specialises in supplying flexible high-conductivity copper and aluminium busbars, designed to optimise power distribution in complex electrical systems.

BRAR’s busbars are distinguished by their flexibility, making them ideal for the automotive industry. Thanks to this property, they facilitate installation and absorb vibrations and thermal expansion, ensuring effective integration and greater reliability of the entire electrical system. Moreover, leveraging its expertise, BRAR offers co-design capabilities and support in the development of busbars, assisting customers at every stage of the process.Brar is proud to be IATF 16949:2016 certified, an international quality management standard specific to the automotive sector. This certification demonstrates our ability to produce electrical busbars with the highest levels of precision and reliability, meeting the stringent requirements of the automotive market. 

Come to visit us at our stand to learn more!.

Braxton Manufacturing

Braxton Manufacturing was founded in 1964 in central Connecticut, an area internationally known as a center of precision tool and die making with a highly skilled workforce. In 1972, a second manufacturing facility was opened in southern California to supply deep-drawn components to the growing west coast customer base.

Today, the 60,000-square-foot Watertown, Connecticut facility and the 30,000-square-foot Tustin, California facility are modern, state-of-the-art production plants that provide identical engineering and production capabilities on both coasts. Braxton currently meets the demanding requirements of customers in a wide range of industries, including Medical, Communications, Aerospace, specialty Automotive and Electronics.

Breathe Battery Technologies (“Breathe”) is the technology partner of choice for world-class organisations developing battery-powered experiences.  

Breathe focuses on three critical areas: performance (maximum energy density, charging, and lifetime), development efficiency (accelerated innovation, resource-efficient validation), and economics (delivering more performance at lower cost across the battery lifecycle).  

Through solutions spanning cell design, chemistry optimisation, cell prototyping, validation and battery system control, Breathe enables companies to do more with less. Since spinning out of Imperial College London in 2019, Breathe has partnered with iconic brands including Volvo Cars, OPPO, Polestar, Bang & Olufsen, and more, enabling software-defined products to deliver exceptional user experiences.

At Breyer Energy Solutions division,  calenders IONPRESS and IONDRY for  manufacturing electrode film for lithium-ion batteries have been developed and supplied over the past 10 years. Calender lines (Roller press) BREYER IONPress  for electrode production, anode and cathode. BREYER IONDry calender lines for the dry coating and processing of battery materials. BREYER's many years of experience in the field of calender manufacturing made it possible to develop a system that meets the high precision requirements in electrode manufacture. Ask for the new dry coating resp dry processing technology! The precise and reliable calender system allows extremely low thickness tolerances. The company is based in Germany, has been successfully operating internationally for 75 years.

Brofind® leads the way in advanced solutions for VOC emissions treatment and solvent recovery, backed by over 30 years of expertise in quality, innovation, and sustainability. Dedicated to the battery recycling and manufacturing industries, Brofind® offers a complete range of emissions management and solvent recovery systems that help clients meet stringent environmental regulations.

The performance of any battery, whether in terms of its capacity, lifetime or energy density, is ultimately down to the intrinsic properties of the materials that comprise its anode, cathode, electrolyte and SEI. Bruker has developed a comprehensive suite of characterization techniques to enable scientist to understand and optimize the physical and chemical properties, performance and stability of all battery components and the fully assembled battery cells.

Bry-Air is a global leader in advanced moisture control and desiccant dehumidification solutions, delivering precise humidity management for critical industrial environments. We specialize in ultra-low humidity control for lithium-ion battery manufacturing, enabling optimal conditions across electrode processing, cell assembly, and storage.

Our proprietary desiccant technologies ensure consistent dew point control, improved product quality, and energy-efficient operations in giga-scale battery facilities. With a strong focus on moisture-sensitive processes, Bry-Air helps minimize defects, enhance yield, and ensure operational reliability.

Serving EV, energy storage, and advanced materials industries, we offer customized, scalable solutions backed by decades of expertise and global installations. Bry-Air partners with leading manufacturers to create controlled environments where moisture is managed with precision.

Brückner Maschinenbau is the world market leader in the field of film stretching technology. Brückner's lines guarantee efficient, profitable and reliable production of a wide variety of flexible film types, which are used as high-quality packaging material and in technical applications. Brückner’s solutions for battery separator film production are based on extensive in house R&D activities and are in production at several leading battery separator film manufacturers.

BST is a leading manufacturer of inline quality assurance for web-based production processes. With over 60 years of experience in various industries, BST continues to set technological standards, contributing to efficient and sustainable production. In battery production, BST solutions guarantee perfect results from coating to cell assembling. This enables producers to sustainably reduce waste and thus produce more cost-effectively. Or as the BST slogan promises: perfecting your performance.

BST is part of the elexis Group, a globally operating company for future-oriented high-technology, with manufacturing, service, and sales locations on every continent.
Bulloneria Usorini is a manufacturer of special fasteners for automotive applications, certified to IATF 16949 standards.

Business France is the national agency supporting the international development of the French economy, responsible for fostering export growth by French businesses, as well as promoting and facilitating international investment in France. It promotes France's companies, business image and nationwide attractiveness as an investment location, and also runs the V.I.E international internship program. Business France has 1,500 personnel, both in France and in 58 countries throughout the world.

Lithium-ion cells have become an indispensable part of the modern mobile world, from smartphones to electric cars – here, BYK additives are of great importance, as they make the production process more efficient and ensure better product properties. In the manufacturing of Li-ion batteries, for example, the good dispersion of particles is crucial for the performance, as is the control of interfaces and the perfect coating of substrates. Additives BYK supplies to this market are mainly used in the production of electrodes and ceramic-coated separators.

Bühler offers a wide range of solutions for the crucial process steps in LIB cell production. They include continuous twin-screw electrode slurry mixers and solutions for wet grinding active materials and precursors. Our innovative process solutions are designed to reduce costs and increase yields.

C3 Prozess- and Analysentechnik GmbH was founded in 1986. Since then, we have seen ourselves as a specialized distribution partner for measuring devices and laboratory equipment in various application fields. With our partners THINKY Corporation, Gamry Instruments and Kolibrik s.r.o. we offer a broad range of products and devices for battery and fuel cell development/testing as well as for other related energy conversion/storage applications.

We primarily operate in the DACH region and support our customers throughout the entire lifecycle of a solution. From pre-purchase consulting to installation and training, as well as service, support, and application consulting during ongoing operations, we are a reliable partner at every stage.

Cabot Corporation is a leading global specialty chemicals and performance materials company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, USA. Our businesses deliver a broad range of products and solutions to customers in every corner of the globe, serving key industries such as transportation, infrastructure, environment and consumer. We are the only global player with a comprehensive product portfolio of additive materials for battery applications, including conductive additives, fumed metal oxides for cathode, separator and electrolyte stability, and aerogel for cell barriers to mitigate thermal runaway.

Caresoft Global is a technology-driven global engineering solutions company addressing challenges in product development, cost optimization, manufacturing, and aftermarket for major automotive OEMs, off-highway, and commercial vehicle manufacturers, as well as their suppliers.

Our award-winning technologies, combined with advanced processes, enable customers to gain actionable insights that accelerate R&D programs, support strategic growth decisions, reduce costs, and improve overall efficiency.

ACCIÓ - Catalonia Trade & Investment is the Catalan Government’s agency for business competitiveness. It is the public facing organisation working to contribute to the transformation of Catalan companies. It is driven by three main goals: to increase the productivity of Catalan companies, to accompany them in their transformation and global positioning challenges, and, finally, to strengthen the attractiveness of Catalonia as a destination for high-value foreign investment. These goals are designed to have a positive impact on economic growth and job creation. Catalonia Trade & Investment promotes innovation, internationalisation, trade and funding of Catalan companies and startups. In addition, it offers specialised one-stop-shop services to international investors and corporations, attracting foreign direct investment to Barcelona and Catalonia. Headquartered in Barcelona, ACCIÓ - Catalonia Trade & Investment operates from 40 offices around the world, covering over 100 markets.

Flexible Printed Circuit is a core strength of CEE PCB, especially for EV and energy-storage applications. Since 2000, we have specialized in flexible printed circuits, rigid-flex boards, rigid PCBs, and FPCA, supporting customers from R&D and engineering to manufacturing and sales. Our solutions are designed for demanding applications such as battery management systems, cell connection systems, and other power electronics where flexibility, reliability, and consistent quality are critical. With four advanced production bases in China and Thailand, we combine strong technical capability with scalable manufacturing to support global customers in the fast-growing e-mobility and energy-storage sectors. CEE PCB is recognized as a key high-tech enterprise under China’s National Torch Program, serves as Vice Chairman of CPCA, and contributes to industry standards. We are committed to helping customers build safer, smarter, and more efficient battery systems.

CeLLife Technologies is a leading innovator in battery cell analytics and battery lifecycle management solutions, specializing in battery cell testing, grading, and tracking technologies. Our mission is to empower the global shift toward a circular economy by delivering the most accurate, fastest, and scalable solutions for battery manufacturing, recycling, and second-life applications. At the core of our offerings is the Electrical Fingerprint (EFP™), a patented, AI powered technology that provides the industry’s most accurate analytics, capturing 1,000x more data points per test compared to traditional methods. With speeds of just 2-5 seconds per cell, the EFP™ significantly improves operational efficiency and cost-effectiveness. Our solutions are trusted across industries to optimize battery quality control, extend product lifecycles, and minimize environmental impact. By combining innovation, sustainability, and efficiency, CeLLife is shaping the future of battery diagnostics and resource recovery. We redefine battery quality.

CellMine has developed a new generation of battery recycling technology designed to unlock domestic battery material production in the West. Our sulphate-free process converts lithium-ion battery waste streams into high-value battery materials while reducing costs, waste generation and environmental impact compared with conventional recycling methods.

Current hydrometallurgical recycling routes generate significant sodium sulphate waste streams, creating major cost, environmental and permitting challenges that are preventing large-scale battery material production and recycling in Europe and North America. CellMine’s technology is designed to overcome this “sulphate wall” by recovering critical minerals and producing high performing cathode materials without generating these problematic waste streams.

By enabling localised recovery and reprocessing of critical battery minerals CellMine aims to reduce reliance on imported materials and strengthen local battery manufacturing capabilities. The company is currently scaling its technology through kilogram-scale production to support demonstration activities.

Research fields of CELEST members include Li-, post-Li-batteries and alternative electrochemical energy storage conversion systems. The Cluster of Excellence POLiS (Post Lithium Storage) is one of CELEST‘s main activities in the post-lithium area: The focus is on sustainable alternatives based on sodium, potassium, magnesium, calcium, aluminium and chloride ions.

COFICAB is a global leader in the design, manufacturing, and sales of wires and cables, primarily for the automotive industry. Coherent Corp. is providing laser sources, processing heads and complete laser systems for a variety of battery manufacturing applications and is leading the way with innovative solutions for battery cells, battery packs, and interconnections. From research and development to serial production, our modular and scalable products are perfectly tailored to meet diverse needs.

R&D Engineers worldwide are using the COMSOL Multiphysics® simulation software to help drive the transition to electric vehicles (EVs), renewable energy systems, and mass electrification. By incorporating single-physics and multiphysics modeling into the design of electric motors, batteries, and charging solutions, engineering teams are able to create high-fidelity models that match real-world counterparts and use those to understand and predict system behavior and optimize designs. COMSOL is a global provider of simulation software used in all fields of engineering, manufacturing, and scientific research to simulate designs, devices, and processes. The platform product, COMSOL Multiphysics®, includes workspaces for multiphysics and single-physics modeling, building and maintaining custom simulation apps, and model and app management. Add-on products connect seamlessly via the platform to bring specialized functionality for electromagnetics, structural mechanics, acoustics, fluid flow, heat transfer, electrochemistry, and chemical engineering. To learn more about COMSOL, see: https://www.comsol.de

The Coroplast Group is a globally successful, family-run company headquartered in Wuppertal, encompassing three brands: Coroplast Tape, Coroflex, and WeWire. Over its 90-year history, the Group has transformed from a local manufacturer into a global player and technology leader in the fields of Technical Adhesive Tapes, Wires & Cables, and Wire Harnesses. Coroplast Tape and Coroflex will be presenting their products live at the Battery Show this year. The Coroplast Tape business unit develops and produces innovative adhesive tape solutions, as evidenced by our many years of trusted cooperation with automotive manufacturers, first-tier suppliers, as well as trade, commerce, and industry. The Coroflex business unit creates and manufactures wire and cable solutions for the global market. We are pioneers in the field of e-mobility and offer customized solutions for mechanical and plant engineering, as well as for the automation and electrical industries. Come and visit our booth!

Over 30 years, Creatique Group designs and manufactures cells interfaces & manual & automatic industrial test-connectors for modules & pack, designed for over 300 000 or 1 000 000 connection cycles. Such product requires a lot of expertise to avoid mistakes or accidents. Our know-how will help you to find the right solution to test your product. Creatique is able to follow you from the establishment of your specification to your commissioning.

fields.exhdesc_t:
The Fraunhofer Institute for High-Speed Dynamics, Ernst Mach Institute, Fraunhofer EMI is a world-leading research institute in high-speed dynamics. The institute conducts research on fast processes through experiments and simulations, with a focus on enhancing safety and resilience. Specifically, the research focuses on processes which occur within fractions of a second, such as car crash, battery explosion, or collision in space. Based on highly instrumented tests and simulations, enhanced safety concepts are developed, for utilization amongst others in the automotive, aviation, space and defense sectors. 

As regards battery safety, Fraunhofer EMI offers analysis, evaluation and optimization of safety at the levels of cells, modules and overall systems. A research facility was built specifically to allow entire traction batteries to be tested under abuse conditions. This test center works for numerous leading companies and brands. The interplay between experiment and simulation allows battery systems to be efficiently understood, optimized and further developed.

The infrastructure at Fraunhofer EMI for characterizing safety relevant processes of lithium-ion batteries comprises:

  • a Battery crash system 
  • Quasi-static and dynamic mechanical test benches

fields.exhnamesort_t: fraunhofer institute for industrial mathematics itwm
fields.exhdesc_t:
The Fraunhofer Institute for Industrial Mathematics ITWM is one of the leading institutes for applied mathematics. It bridges theoretical research and practical application across industries, including automotive and energy systems.

At the Battery Show Europe 2026, Fraunhofer ITWM presents cutting-edge technologies for battery development and production: In particular we show BEST (Battery and Electrochemistry Simulation Tool) that enables detailed 3D electrochemical simulations to analyze cell behavior and optimize battery design. With FOAM we simulate the foam encapsulation of battery modules for more efficient manufacturing processes. Terahertz measurement technology provides precise, non-destructive quality monitoring of battery foil coatings.

With these innovative simulation tools and measurement systems, Fraunhofer ITWM supports manufacturers in significantly enhancing production efficiency, improving product quality, and conserving resources sustainably.

fields.exhnamesort_t: fraunhofer institute for manufacturing and advanced materials ifam
fields.exhdesc_t:
Fraunhofer IFAM is one of Europe's leading research institutions for advanced materials and manufacturing technologies. The institute offers contract research along the entire value chain: from functional materials to shaping and adhesive bonding technology, surface functionalization, development of complete parts or complex systems, as well as digital transformation. With about 700 employees at seven locations, it develops innovative solutions for key future topics such as sustainable mobility, energy transition, digitalization and production, and resource efficiency – and brings them to industrial application.

 

Furthermore, Fraunhofer IFAM is one of Germany's leading research institutions for battery technology, covering the entire value chain from material development and battery cell manufacturing to quality assurance. Research activities include the development of electrode materials, electrolytes, and separators for lithium-ion and solid-state batteries. A unique feature is battery recycling: the institute develops innovative processes for recovering critical raw materials from spent batteries, contributing to a sustainable circular economy.
fields.exhname_t: Fraunhofer Institute for Manufacturing and Advanced Materials IFAM

fields.exhnamesort_t: fraunhofer institute for manufacturing engineering and automation ipa
fields.exhdesc_t: We produce the future: sustainable, personalized, smart Fraunhofer IPA covers the entire field of production technology and works on an interdisciplinary basis with industrial companies from leading sectors. Social, technical and environmentally relevant key and future topics are addressed in industrial and research projects. Our focus at the Center for Digitalized Battery Cell Production - is to realize a sustainable and future-oriented battery value chain. With comprehensive expertise in factory planning, process development, quality management and the production of cylindrical cells, we create technological advances and competitive advantages for our customers. We focus on a holistic perspective that also includes the end of the battery life cycle in order to promote a sustainable circular economy. Our unique selling point is consistent digitalization along the entire value chain.

fields.exhnamesort_t: fraunhofer institute for silicate research isc
fields.exhdesc_t:
Fraunhofer ISC in Würzburg develops ultrasound-based, non-destructive diagnostics to analyze material states, aging, state of charge and state of health of lithium-ion cells, enabling reliable lifetime predictions and optimized production. In parallel, ISC operates along the entire value chain of lithium-ion, sodium-ion and solid-state batteries and is developing a modular, water-based roll-to-roll delamination plant that gently separates electrode materials from carrier foils, directly recovers active materials from production scrap and end-of-life cells for reuse in new batteries, reduces dependence on critical raw materials and supports higher recycled content in future battery generations.

Testing and Analytics of Battery Cells and Modules

fields.exhdesc_t: The Fraunhofer Institute for Structural Durability and System Reliability LBF in Darmstadt has stood for safe and reliable solutions since 1938 – and has been a part of the Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft since 1962. In 2026, the institute is focusing on its orientation and combining classic engineering expertise with digital twins and AI methods to bring reliable, recyclable products to market more quickly. The focus is on the interactions at the interfaces between materials, components, and systems (MCS). With around 300 employees, Fraunhofer LBF supports companies throughout the entire development process – from material selection and component evaluation to system integration, validation, and operational monitoring. Clients come from the mobility sector (aviation, agriculture, shipbuilding, and vehicle construction), mechanical and plant engineering, security and defense, and the chemical industry, among others.

fields.exhdesc_t:
The Fraunhofer ISIT in Itzehoe is one of Europe’s most advanced research facilities for microelectronics and microsystems technology. At the heart of the institute are its cleanroom facilities, which are large enough not only to conduct research but also to manufacture the developed microchips on an industrial scale.

At ISIT, 180 scientists work in close collaboration with industry partners to develop power electronics components and microsystems with fine moving structures for sensor technology (pressure, motion, biochemical analysis, etc.) and actuator technology (valves, scanners, mirror arrays, etc.), including the necessary packaging technology. These miniaturized components are used in medicine, environmental and transportation engineering, communications technology, the automotive industry, and mechanical engineering.

Das Fraunhofer IWS entwickelt komplexe Systemlösungen in der Laser- und Werkstofftechnik.

Innovationen für die Batterie der Zukunft – darauf richtet das Advanced Battery Technology Center (ABTC) seinen Forschungsfokus und erarbeitet neue Konzepte für die gesamte Prozesskette der Batteriezellfertigung. Es erforscht Struktur-Eigenschaftsbeziehungen für neue Materialien in Batteriezellen und entwickelt effiziente sowie kosten- und ressourcensparende Produktionsprozesse.

Für unsere Partner und Kunden bieten wir so eine F&E Plattform, die Material- und Prozessinnovationen bis zur anwendungsnahen Bewertung neuer Zellkonzepte umfasst.

With more than 10,000 employees in over 100 countries, Jotun is a trusted partner throughout the EV value chain. Guided by our mission, Jotun Protects Property, we are leading the way in protecting and advancing battery systems for the future of mobility.

(SHA: 600699, "Joyson Electronics").

JR Energy Solution is a South Korea-based battery technology and manufacturing company specializing in high-performance battery components and advanced electrode production. Founded in 2022 by experienced battery industry professionals, the company focuses on accelerating the commercialization of next-generation battery technologies through a flexible manufacturing and foundry model.

JR Energy Solution operates with a foundry-style business model similar to that used in the semiconductor industry. This approach allows battery technology developers and manufacturers to outsource electrode and cell production while maintaining flexibility in design and technology integration. Through this model, the company enables customers to accelerate product development, scale production capacity efficiently, and bring new battery technologies to market more quickly.

JSP is pleased to be exhibiting at the Battery Show Expo, where we will showcase ARPRO (EPP) a material designed to support the evolving needs of the battery and electrification markets. ARPRO combines lightweight performance, durability, and design flexibility, helping manufacturers improve protection, efficiency, and sustainability across battery systems and components.

At our stand, visitors can explore how ARPRO enable innovative solutions for thermal management, impact protection, vibration damping, and space optimisation, key requirements in modern battery applications. With a strong focus on circularity, recycled content, and energy-efficient manufacturing, JSP supports customers in meeting both technical and environmental targets.

Our team will be on hand to discuss real-world applications, development support, and how we work in partnership with customers to bring advanced battery concepts into production. We look forward to connecting with industry professionals and sharing how JSP materials help shape the future of battery design.

Visit: https://www.arpro.com/industries/automotive/battery-systems

JW Froehlich is an expert for quality assurance in series production developing test stands that include pre-testing as well as the end-of-line testing of batteries. Following the electrical pre-tests of the batteries or modules before they have been fully mounted to form a battery pack, leak testing using air or helium sniffing tests, followed by EOL functional tests are performed. 

Batteries that do not fully meet the test criteria are subjected to repeat tests following repair.   For the preliminary test of the incompletely assembled batteries, information is read out from the individual modules, compared with defined limit values, and evaluated. 

Furthermore, JW Froehlich offers individual mapping for the determination of the ideal leak tightness test procedure for battery components such as housing, cooling systems, rupture discs and more.

fields.exhdesc_t: For more than 60 years, Konzelmann GmbH has stood for innovations made of plastics. The family-run company is headquartered in Löchgau, Germany and has an office in Detroit, USA as well. Konzelmann develops polymeric components and systems for friction optimization as well as emission reduction. Its customers are major OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers in the automotive, medical and industrial sectors. Konzelmann's experts follow a holistic approach to finding solutions: through intensive listening and many years of expertise in the development of special technical applications, individual solutions with a holistic view of product and process interfaces are created in exchange with the customer. The result is reduced production costs with superior product properties. Current example are the KBerstring® developed in-house, which increases the safety of batteries in the course of e-mobility, our purkon®2000 material development for comprehensive leakage protection from electrolysis to fuel cells and the ID Sealing (REDI).

KRAH – Your Trusted Partner for Automotive Resistor Solutions. As the global market leader in automotive resistor technology, KRAH brings decades of expertise to your e-mobility projects. For over 50 years, the KRAH Group has been supplying high-quality electrical resistors for HVAC systems, ignition noise suppression, and engine cooling in the automotive industry. Our production sites are certified according to IATF 16949 and ISO 14001, as well as TISAX, ensuring the highest standards in quality and environmental management. With a strong global presence, we develop and manufacture resistors that meet industry standards such as AEC-Q200 and UL certification. Whether you need high-voltage braking resistors, precharge and discharge resistors, or high-voltage coolant heaters, KRAH is your innovative and reliable partner for advanced e-mobility solutions. Let’s shape the future of mobility together!

At ST Charger, we believe a product should do more than simply exist—it should make a difference. Since our founding in 2009, this philosophy has guided everything we do, from product design to manufacturing.

We specialize in developing reliable and innovative charging solutions that help our customers stand out in competitive markets. Our chargers are designed to move beyond price-driven competition while reducing operational risks and lowering overall costs, including after-sales service.

To achieve this, we continuously invest in market research, advanced R&D, and efficient production. This commitment to innovation and quality has earned the trust of leading brands worldwide and continues to drive our growth in the global electric mobility industry.

Kuraray Co., Ltd. is a globally active specialty chemicals company headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, founded in 1926. The company develops and manufactures innovative high‑performance materials, including resins, chemicals, fibers, and advanced polymers, serving a wide range of industries such as automotive, packaging, electronics, healthcare, and construction. Kuraray is recognized as a leading supplier of GENESTARTM PA9T, polyvinyl alcohol (PVOH), ethylene vinyl alcohol (EVOH), and thermoplastic elastomers, as well as synthetic fibers and activated carbon.  With operations in more than 30 countries, Kuraray combines proprietary polymer and synthetic chemistry technologies with strong research and development capabilities to deliver solutions that meet complex customer needs. Guided by its mission “For people and the planet—to achieve what no one else can,” Kuraray focuses on creating new value through innovation, improving environmental performance, and enhancing quality of life worldwide.

kurybees is an independent R&D studio specialized in battery cell technologies, combining a testing laboratory, advanced simulation tools, and strategic consulting. Through its SaaS platform, KuryLabs, kurybees centralizes battery testing data, simulation models, and engineering workflows into a single integrated environment. This enables manufacturers, integrators, and industrial players to design, test, and optimize battery systems more efficiently and faster. The platform provides access to a wide range of battery cell data, advanced electro-thermal and aging simulations, and decision-making tools to support technology selection and validation. By reducing the need for costly internal testing infrastructures and accelerating R&D cycles, kurybees allows companies to save up to 75% of development costs and gain up to 18 months in their validation process kurybees supports a wide range of industries including electric mobility, industrial equipment, drones, and stationary energy storage, helping them build more efficient, reliable, and sustainable battery solutions .

KYOS Energy Analytics is a market leader of financial-analytical software and advisory services tailored for energy companies. Our KYOS Analytical Platform is trusted by over 100 companies globally, making it the premier solution for valuation and risk management of renewable projects (incl BESS and PPAs).

The platform empowers clients to evaluate the market risks of renewable projects and dynamic market hedges, both standalone or co-located. It enables the assessment of business cases and provides bankable revenue forecasts for nearly all European markets. Key components include our proprietary fundamental power market model and a Monte Carlo engine, which generate realistic price and production simulations. Finally, our sophisticated real-time BESS optimizer software allows our clients to generate revenues from operational assets using a multi-market strategy.

KYOS supports various stakeholders: project developers, investors, producers, aggregators, and off-takers. In addition to our software, we offer advisory services for BESS valuation and market risk assessment.

L&L Products combines expertise in materials science, advanced engineering, and manufacturing process optimization for customers to develop unique solutions that deliver structural reinforcement, substrate bonding, static sealing, and acoustic improvement for automotive, aerospace, commercial vehicle, construction, and consumer products applications. For nearly 70 years, our skilled chemists, scientists, and engineers have collaborated with customers around the world to make products lighter, stronger, and quieter. Today, L&L has over 1200 employees worldwide, 10 manufacturing facilities, and locations in 15 countries.
