Established in 2002, Lead Intelligent Equipment (LEAD) is one of the largest suppliers of innovative new energy manufacturing equipment worldwide. With a strong focus on designing, engineering, and building advanced manufacturing solutions, LEAD serves some of the world’s largest companies in the automotive, renewable energy, and technology sectors. LEAD’s expertise spans eight key industries: lithium-ion EV batteries, EV module and pack equipment, solar PV panels, 3C equipment, hydrogen fuel cells, laser precision processing, connected factories, and smart logistics. LEAD delivers fully integrated, automated smart manufacturing solutions, covering all stages of production—from planning and raw material processing to assembly, testing, and final packaging. This end-to-end integration drives production efficiency, improves product quality, and reduces costs through advanced digital technologies. LEAD's flexibility in chemistry, cell size, and format delivers customized solutions, backed by expert pre-sales, after-sales, and service teams to provide comprehensive, localized support.

KURZ is a global leader in thin-film technology with over 5,800 employees at more than 50 locations worldwide. Building on decades of experience in advanced coating technologies, KURZ brings proven expertise into the battery sector - with high-performance materials and fully operational digital solutions.

Through our European joint venture Horizon-Kurz, we develop and manufacture coated lithium-ion separator films and carbon primer-coated current collectors in Europe. This regional production ensures compliance with EU quality and sustainability standards while strengthening supply chain security and delivery reliability for battery and energy storage manufacturers.

Our coatings are optimized to improve safety, durability, and lifecycle performance - and are compatible with both wet and dry electrode processing. We also offer advanced protection technologies, such as IGNIRIT® flame-retardant coatings and high-temperature barrier films for thermal shielding in battery and vehicle systems.

In addition, KURZ Digital offers a fully deployed and operational Digital Battery Passport solution. Designed to meet the requirements of the EU Battery Regulation, it enables the structured capture, management, and exchange of product, material, and CO₂ data across the battery value chain. 

With a strong combination of EU-based manufacturing and digital regulatory readiness, KURZ delivers end-to-end solutions for the battery industry

LEONI is global provider of products, solutions and services for energy and data management in the automotive sector and various other industries. The foundation for today’s global player laid in 1569. Our largest customer group is the international car, commercial vehicle and component supply industry. LEONI supports its customers as an innovation partner and solution provider with distinctive development and system expertise on the way to increasingly sustainable and connected mobility concepts by developing the next generation of cables. Increasing automation, alternative drives, autonomous driving, connectivity and lightweight design make high requirements on performance and innovative strength of automotive cables. Even more, the automotive industry expects not only high reliability but also weight reduction and the optimization of installation space. With our comprehensive product range of standard and special cables, we are responding to these challenges.

LESSMÜLLER LASERTECHNIK GmbH was founded in 1990 as a technology company for the optimization, stabilization and monitoring of laser beam systems. Since 1997, the focus has been on the MONITORING of LASER WELDING PROCESSES. Under the leadership of company founder Eckhard Lessmüller and Managing Director Christian Truckenbrodt, Lessmüller Lasertechnik has gradually developed into the market leader for systems for quality monitoring of laser welding processes. By using PHOTODIODES, CAMERA SYSTEMS with controlled ambient light and optical coherence tomography ( OCT ), we offer our customers suitable solutions for process monitoring in areas such as SEAM TRACKING, SEAM INSPECTION, MEASUREMENT of the WELDING DEPHT and HAIRPIN WELDING and ensure optimum QUALITY ASSURANCE in laser welding processes.

Li.plus GmbH is a leading provider of highly efficient characterization solutions for batteries and battery systems.
Founded as a spin-off of the Technical University of Munich, the company offers a patented diagnostic solution capable of precisely determining the condition of individual cells, modules, and complete systems within just a few milliseconds.

Using its innovative measurement technology, key parameters related to quality, aging, and safety are determined in a microinvasive and fully analytical manner.
This makes the technology suitable for applications across the entire value chain – from quality assurance in production and maintenance processes to evaluation for second-life applications.

In addition, Li.plus GmbH supports its customers with specialized solutions for R&D, contacting fixtures, and tailored engineering services.

Now we are spinning off the service to our new brand -- LAB021, expanding service and product portfolio while maintaining excellent quality and quicker respond.

LMI Technologies is a global leader in industrial inspection, advancing manufacturing quality and productivity through smart 3D and 2D vision technologies. Our award-winning Gocator® portfolio includes FactorySmart® 3D laser, snapshot, and line confocal sensors, as well as Gocator® 2D Smart Cameras, delivering fast, accurate, and reliable inspection across a wide range of manufacturing applications.

Gocator solutions combine high-performance imaging with edge-native processing and the GoPxL® unified vision platform, enabling manufacturers to deploy measurement, defect detection, OCR, traceability, and AI-based inspection with minimal integration effort. Visit www.lmi3d.com or contact contact@lmi3d.com.

With our expertise in materials and processing, we support our customers from concept to production. Visit us at the Battery Show Stuttgart to discover how Startech24 can enhance your applications with reliable and innovative insulation solutions.

4a engineering GmbH, based in Traboch, Austria, specializes, among others, in battery abuse testing services and the development of advanced battery abuse test equipment. The company designs and manufactures state-of-the-art testing systems, including pressure-tight thermal runaway chambers for electro-thermal-mechanical testing of cells, modules, and small packs, as well as mechanical testing systems for characterizing battery cells. With extensive expertise in battery safety, abuse simulation, and custom testing solutions, 4a engineering supports the development and validation of next-generation battery technologies. In 1972, a second manufacturing facility was opened in southern California to supply deep-drawn components to the growing west coast customer base.

Today, the 60,000-square-foot Watertown, Connecticut facility and the 30,000-square-foot Tustin, California facility are modern, state-of-the-art production plants that provide identical engineering and production capabilities on both coasts. Braxton currently meets the demanding requirements of customers in a wide range of industries, including Medical, Communications, Aerospace, specialty Automotive and Electronics.

Breathe Battery Technologies (“Breathe”) is the technology partner of choice for world-class organisations developing battery-powered experiences.  

Breathe focuses on three critical areas: performance (maximum energy density, charging, and lifetime), development efficiency (accelerated innovation, resource-efficient validation), and economics (delivering more performance at lower cost across the battery lifecycle).  

Through solutions spanning cell design, chemistry optimisation, cell prototyping, validation and battery system control, Breathe enables companies to do more with less. Since spinning out of Imperial College London in 2019, Breathe has partnered with iconic brands including Volvo Cars, OPPO, Polestar, Bang & Olufsen, and more, enabling software-defined products to deliver exceptional user experiences.

At Breyer Energy Solutions division,  calenders IONPRESS and IONDRY for  manufacturing electrode film for lithium-ion batteries have been developed and supplied over the past 10 years. Calender lines (Roller press) BREYER IONPress  for electrode production, anode and cathode. BREYER IONDry calender lines for the dry coating and processing of battery materials. BREYER's many years of experience in the field of calender manufacturing made it possible to develop a system that meets the high precision requirements in electrode manufacture. Brofind® leads the way in advanced solutions for VOC emissions treatment and solvent recovery, backed by over 30 years of expertise in quality, innovation, and sustainability. The performance of any battery, whether in terms of its capacity, lifetime or energy density, is ultimately down to the intrinsic properties of the materials that comprise its anode, cathode, electrolyte and SEI. Bruker has developed a comprehensive suite of characterization techniques to enable scientist to understand and optimize the physical and chemical properties, performance and stability of all battery components and the fully assembled battery cells.

Bry-Air is a global leader in advanced moisture control and desiccant dehumidification solutions, delivering precise humidity management for critical industrial environments. We specialize in ultra-low humidity control for lithium-ion battery manufacturing, enabling optimal conditions across electrode processing, cell assembly, and storage.

Our proprietary desiccant technologies ensure consistent dew point control, improved product quality, and energy-efficient operations in giga-scale battery facilities. With a strong focus on moisture-sensitive processes, Bry-Air helps minimize defects, enhance yield, and ensure operational reliability.

Serving EV, energy storage, and advanced materials industries, we offer customized, scalable solutions backed by decades of expertise and global installations. Bry-Air partners with leading manufacturers to create controlled environments where moisture is managed with precision.

BST is a leading manufacturer of inline quality assurance for web-based production processes. In the manufacturing of Li-ion batteries, for example, the good dispersion of particles is crucial for the performance, as is the control of interfaces and the perfect coating of substrates. Additives BYK supplies to this market are mainly used in the production of electrodes and ceramic-coated separators.

C3 Prozess- and Analysentechnik GmbH was founded in 1986. Our award-winning technologies, combined with advanced processes, enable customers to gain actionable insights that accelerate R&D programs, support strategic growth decisions, reduce costs, and improve overall efficiency.

ACCIÓ - Catalonia Trade & Investment is the Catalan Government’s agency for business competitiveness. It is the public facing organisation working to contribute to the transformation of Catalan companies. It is driven by three main goals: to increase the productivity of Catalan companies, to accompany them in their transformation and global positioning challenges, and, finally, to strengthen the attractiveness of Catalonia as a destination for high-value foreign investment. These goals are designed to have a positive impact on economic growth and job creation. Catalonia Trade & Investment promotes innovation, internationalisation, trade and funding of Catalan companies and startups. In addition, it offers specialised one-stop-shop services to international investors and corporations, attracting foreign direct investment to Barcelona and Catalonia. Headquartered in Barcelona, ACCIÓ - Catalonia Trade & Investment operates from 40 offices around the world, covering over 100 markets.

Flexible Printed Circuit is a core strength of CEE PCB, especially for EV and energy-storage applications. Since 2000, we have specialized in flexible printed circuits, rigid-flex boards, rigid PCBs, and FPCA, supporting customers from R&D and engineering to manufacturing and sales. Our solutions are designed for demanding applications such as battery management systems, cell connection systems, and other power electronics where flexibility, reliability, and consistent quality are critical. With four advanced production bases in China and Thailand, we combine strong technical capability with scalable manufacturing to support global customers in the fast-growing e-mobility and energy-storage sectors. CEE PCB is recognized as a key high-tech enterprise under China’s National Torch Program, serves as Vice Chairman of CPCA, and contributes to industry standards. We are committed to helping customers build safer, smarter, and more efficient battery systems.

CeLLife Technologies is a leading innovator in battery cell analytics and battery lifecycle management solutions, specializing in battery cell testing, grading, and tracking technologies. Our mission is to empower the global shift toward a circular economy by delivering the most accurate, fastest, and scalable solutions for battery manufacturing, recycling, and second-life applications. At the core of our offerings is the Electrical Fingerprint (EFP™), a patented, AI powered technology that provides the industry’s most accurate analytics, capturing 1,000x more data points per test compared to traditional methods. With speeds of just 2-5 seconds per cell, the EFP™ significantly improves operational efficiency and cost-effectiveness. Our solutions are trusted across industries to optimize battery quality control, extend product lifecycles, and minimize environmental impact. By combining innovation, sustainability, and efficiency, CeLLife is shaping the future of battery diagnostics and resource recovery. We redefine battery quality.

CellMine has developed a new generation of battery recycling technology designed to unlock domestic battery material production in the West. Our sulphate-free process converts lithium-ion battery waste streams into high-value battery materials while reducing costs, waste generation and environmental impact compared with conventional recycling methods.

Current hydrometallurgical recycling routes generate significant sodium sulphate waste streams, creating major cost, environmental and permitting challenges that are preventing large-scale battery material production and recycling in Europe and North America. CellMine’s technology is designed to overcome this “sulphate wall” by recovering critical minerals and producing high performing cathode materials without generating these problematic waste streams.

By enabling localised recovery and reprocessing of critical battery minerals CellMine aims to reduce reliance on imported materials and strengthen local battery manufacturing capabilities. The company is currently scaling its technology through kilogram-scale production to support demonstration activities.

R&D Engineers worldwide are using the COMSOL Multiphysics® simulation software to help drive the transition to electric vehicles (EVs), renewable energy systems, and mass electrification. By incorporating single-physics and multiphysics modeling into the design of electric motors, batteries, and charging solutions, engineering teams are able to create high-fidelity models that match real-world counterparts and use those to understand and predict system behavior and optimize designs. COMSOL is a global provider of simulation software used in all fields of engineering, manufacturing, and scientific research to simulate designs, devices, and processes. fields.exhnamesort_t: fraunhofer institute for high-speed dynamics, ernst-mach-institut, emi
fields.exhdesc_t:
The Fraunhofer Institute for High-Speed Dynamics, Ernst Mach Institute, Fraunhofer EMI is a world-leading research institute in high-speed dynamics. The institute conducts research on fast processes through experiments and simulations, with a focus on enhancing safety and resilience. Specifically, the research focuses on processes which occur within fractions of a second, such as car crash, battery explosion, or collision in space. Based on highly instrumented tests and simulations, enhanced safety concepts are developed, for utilization amongst others in the automotive, aviation, space and defense sectors. 

As regards battery safety, Fraunhofer EMI offers analysis, evaluation and optimization of safety at the levels of cells, modules and overall systems. A research facility was built specifically to allow entire traction batteries to be tested under abuse conditions. This test center works for numerous leading companies and brands. The interplay between experiment and simulation allows battery systems to be efficiently understood, optimized and further developed.

The infrastructure at Fraunhofer EMI for characterizing safety relevant processes of lithium-ion batteries comprises:

  • a Battery crash system 
  • Quasi-static and dynamic mechanical test benches
  • In-situ X-ray technology allowing Radiography and CT to image cell-internal failure processes
  • Gas analysis Diagnostics
  • High-speed measurement technology
  • Video and infrared video
fields.exhname_t: Fraunhofer Institute for High-Speed Dynamics, Ernst-Mach-Institut, EMI

fields.exhnamesort_t: fraunhofer institute for industrial mathematics itwm
fields.exhdesc_t:
The Fraunhofer Institute for Industrial Mathematics ITWM is one of the leading institutes for applied mathematics. It bridges theoretical research and practical application across industries, including automotive and energy systems.

At the Battery Show Europe 2026, Fraunhofer ITWM presents cutting-edge technologies for battery development and production: In particular we show BEST (Battery and Electrochemistry Simulation Tool) that enables detailed 3D electrochemical simulations to analyze cell behavior and optimize battery design. With FOAM we simulate the foam encapsulation of battery modules for more efficient manufacturing processes. Terahertz measurement technology provides precise, non-destructive quality monitoring of battery foil coatings.

With these innovative simulation tools and measurement systems, Fraunhofer ITWM supports manufacturers in significantly enhancing production efficiency, improving product quality, and conserving resources sustainably.
fields.exhname_t: Fraunhofer Institute for Industrial Mathematics ITWM

Fraunhofer IFAM is one of Europe's leading research institutions for advanced materials and manufacturing technologies. The institute offers contract research along the entire value chain: from functional materials to shaping and adhesive bonding technology, surface functionalization, development of complete parts or complex systems, as well as digital transformation. With about 700 employees at seven locations, it develops innovative solutions for key future topics such as sustainable mobility, energy transition, digitalization and production, and resource efficiency – and brings them to industrial application.

 

Furthermore, Fraunhofer IFAM is one of Germany's leading research institutions for battery technology, covering the entire value chain from material development and battery cell manufacturing to quality assurance. Research activities include the development of electrode materials, electrolytes, and separators for lithium-ion and solid-state batteries. A unique feature is battery recycling: the institute develops innovative processes for recovering critical raw materials from spent batteries, contributing to a sustainable circular economy.
fields.exhname_t: Fraunhofer Institute for Manufacturing and Advanced Materials IFAM

fields.exhnamesort_t: fraunhofer institute for manufacturing engineering and automation ipa
fields.exhdesc_t: We produce the future: sustainable, personalized, smart Fraunhofer IPA covers the entire field of production technology and works on an interdisciplinary basis with industrial companies from leading sectors. Social, technical and environmentally relevant key and future topics are addressed in industrial and research projects. Our focus at the Center for Digitalized Battery Cell Production - is to realize a sustainable and future-oriented battery value chain. With comprehensive expertise in factory planning, process development, quality management and the production of cylindrical cells, we create technological advances and competitive advantages for our customers. We focus on a holistic perspective that also includes the end of the battery life cycle in order to promote a sustainable circular economy. Our unique selling point is consistent digitalization along the entire value chain.
fields.exhname_t: Fraunhofer Institute for Manufacturing Engineering and Automation IPA

fields.exhnamesort_t: fraunhofer institute for silicate research isc
fields.exhdesc_t:
Fraunhofer ISC in Würzburg develops ultrasound-based, non-destructive diagnostics to analyze material states, aging, state of charge and state of health of lithium-ion cells, enabling reliable lifetime predictions and optimized production. In parallel, ISC operates along the entire value chain of lithium-ion, sodium-ion and solid-state batteries and is developing a modular, water-based roll-to-roll delamination plant that gently separates electrode materials from carrier foils, directly recovers active materials from production scrap and end-of-life cells for reuse in new batteries, reduces dependence on critical raw materials and supports higher recycled content in future battery generations.

Testing and Analytics of Battery Cells and Modules

fields.exhnamesort_t: fraunhofer institute for structural durability and system reliability lbf
fields.exhdesc_t: The Fraunhofer Institute for Structural Durability and System Reliability LBF in Darmstadt has stood for safe and reliable solutions since 1938 – and has been a part of the Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft since 1962. In 2026, the institute is focusing on its orientation and combining classic engineering expertise with digital twins and AI methods to bring reliable, recyclable products to market more quickly. The focus is on the interactions at the interfaces between materials, components, and systems (MCS). With around 300 employees, Fraunhofer LBF supports companies throughout the entire development process – from material selection and component evaluation to system integration, validation, and operational monitoring. Clients come from the mobility sector (aviation, agriculture, shipbuilding, and vehicle construction), mechanical and plant engineering, security and defense, and the chemical industry, among others.

fields.exhdesc_t:
The Fraunhofer ISIT in Itzehoe is one of Europe’s most advanced research facilities for microelectronics and microsystems technology. At the heart of the institute are its cleanroom facilities, which are large enough not only to conduct research but also to manufacture the developed microchips on an industrial scale.

At ISIT, 180 scientists work in close collaboration with industry partners to develop power electronics components and microsystems with fine moving structures for sensor technology (pressure, motion, biochemical analysis, etc.) and actuator technology (valves, scanners, mirror arrays, etc.), including the necessary packaging technology. These miniaturized components are used in medicine, environmental and transportation engineering, communications technology, the automotive industry, and mechanical engineering.

Das Fraunhofer IWS entwickelt komplexe Systemlösungen in der Laser- und Werkstofftechnik.

Innovationen für die Batterie der Zukunft – darauf richtet das Advanced Battery Technology Center (ABTC) seinen Forschungsfokus und erarbeitet neue Konzepte für die gesamte Prozesskette der Batteriezellfertigung. Es erforscht Struktur-Eigenschaftsbeziehungen für neue Materialien in Batteriezellen und entwickelt effiziente sowie kosten- und ressourcensparende Produktionsprozesse.

Für unsere Partner und Kunden bieten wir so eine F&E Plattform, die Material- und Prozessinnovationen bis zur anwendungsnahen Bewertung neuer Zellkonzepte umfasst.

The way into the mobile future is mapped out. Thermal and pressure management currently top the list of innovative developments. The result is heat shields developed especially for lithium-ion battery systems, for example. In the event of a cell malfunction, they prevent the heat from “spilling over” to neighboring cells, a huge safety advantage. DIAvent has proven itself as an intelligent pressure management solution for large batteries for electric and hybrid vehicles. The patented nonwovens it contains reliably ensure multifunctional battery pressure equalization even under extreme conditions. In addition to these innovations, Freudenberg Sealing Technologies offers many other tailor-made products and solutions for components in electric vehicles and fuel cell-based vehicles, such as the electrically conductive nonwoven eCON: It conducts bearing currents and thus possible electrical erosion past the bearing. Noise generation, vibrations and, in extreme cases, rolling bearing failure are thus a thing of the past.
